response.rationale: The item is electronics with days_since_delivery = 16, which exceeds the 15-day electronics window. RET-003 (priority 20) controls over the standard 30-day rule RET-007 (priority 10). Final sale is false, no defect is indicated (defective is null, so RET-020 does not apply), and no goodwill grant or fraud hold is present. Therefore the return is ineligible.
